nodes.title: Aliases admitted from the source
nodes.summary: Under v5, extraction asks for the other names of each entity, and a proposed alias is kept only where the source text of its run holds it.

nodes.title: Approximate node search
nodes.summary: The node layer of search also matches a knowledge node by the trigram word similarity of its aliases, ranks such matches last and says how each node matched.

nodes.title: Document context before chunk reading
nodes.summary: Under v5, an extraction over a multi-chunk document first reads it whole into a document context, records the context and its status on the run, and shows it with every chunk.

nodes.title: Backend territory for aliases in extraction, approximate node search and document context
nodes.summary: The ingestion and query-retrieval modules plus the MCP, REST and env wiring where alias admission, trigram node matching and the preliminary document read would land.

nodes.title: Admit aliases only from the source
nodes.summary: The alias admission check in the node-proposal service, made against the normalized content of the raw information of the run, with directed ingestion exempt.

nodes.title: Default prompt version is v5
nodes.summary: The prompt version a document ingestion runs under when it names none.

nodes.title: Prompt v5 asks for other names
nodes.summary: A v5 extraction prompt, registered beside v1 to v4, that asks for every other name the text gives each entity and keeps every instruction of v4.

nodes.title: Approximate node match
nodes.summary: The trigram route of the node layer, which matches a knowledge node through the word similarity of a normalized alias of at least 5 characters.

nodes.title: Rank approximate reach last
nodes.summary: The search ordering that puts every item reached only through approximately matched nodes after all the others.

nodes.title: Search answers show how a node matched
nodes.summary: The REST search answer and the MCP search tool answer carrying the match and similarity of each hop-0 knowledge node item.

nodes.title: Search item shows how a node matched
nodes.summary: The match and similarity fields on a hop-0 knowledge node search item, kept apart from the assertion flags.

nodes.title: Each chunk is shown the document context
nodes.summary: The per-chunk prompt of a run that holds a document context, which shows the context next to the source metadata and the tail of the previous chunk.

nodes.title: Context model setting
nodes.summary: The configured model for the preliminary reading, with its default, threaded to every place that builds the extraction orchestrator.

nodes.title: Failed preliminary reading continues
nodes.summary: The path where the preliminary reading fails and the extraction goes on to read its chunks without a context.

nodes.title: Preliminary reading produces the document context
nodes.summary: The single whole-document model reading that, under v5, yields and records the document context of a multi-chunk run before its first chunk.

nodes.title: Record the document context on the run
nodes.summary: The persistence of the document context of an LLM run, and of its document context status, through the llm_run repository.

nodes.title: Retry reuses the document context
nodes.summary: The retry path, which keeps a recorded document context and makes a preliminary reading again only when the previous attempt produced none.

nodes.title: Run answers show the document context
nodes.summary: The read-llm-run answers over REST and MCP, and the run-extraction answer, carrying the document context and its status when the run holds them.

nodes.title: Skip the preliminary reading
nodes.summary: The single-chunk and too-long paths, where a v5 extraction makes no preliminary reading and records why.
